spans.s:
ind.
As, according to; correlative to तथा so: it is also commonly used in composition to form adverbs: यथाकालं seasonably, यथाक्रमं regularly, यथान्यायं fitly, suitably, यथाशास्त्रं according to scripture, &c.
E.
यद् what, थाल् aff.

ind.
Proportionably, in due proportion.
E.
यथा as, according to, अंश part, तसि aff.

ind.
As much as, tantum quantum: it is especially used as a term of disrespect.
E.
यथा as, and कथा how.

ind.
Rarely, unfrequently, seldomer than proper.
E.
यथा as much, and कथा how much, with च the particle, and.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
What is right or proper to be done.
E.
यथा, कर्त्तव्य to be done.

adv. (-ल्पं)
As designed.
E.
यथा, and कल्प making.

adv. (-मं)
At pleasure, as you please.
E.
यथा, and काम desire.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Wilful, independant, uncontrolled, following one's own inclinations.
E.
यथा as, according to, काम desire, इनि aff.

adv. n. (-मं)
In order, orderly, successively, methodically.
E.
यथा agreeably to, क्रम order.

adv. n. (-तं)
Applied to a person's being sent away or returning as he came.
E.
यथा, and गत gone.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Foolish, stupid, a fool, a natural.
2 Barbarous, outcast.
E.
यथा as, and जात born, as simple as at birth.

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
Right, true.
ind. or adv. n. (-थं)
Properly, suitably.
noun. (-थं)
Narrative of events, history.
E.
यथा as, and तथा so, with the termination of the neuter gender.

adv.
In any way, any how.
E.
यथा and तथा, &c.

n. adv. (-र्व्वं)
1 In order or succession.
2 Formerly, precedingly, in prior time or place.
E.
यथा as, and पूर्व्व formerly, before.

ind.
According to one's wish or purpose.
E.
यथा, and अभिमत purposed.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Like, resembling, shewing similarly or reflecting.
E.
यथा as, मुख the countenance, and ख aff.

ind.
As, thereto appertaining.
E.
यथा repeated, with the termination of the neuter gender.

mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं)
1 Right, proper.
2 According to the sense.
adv. or ind.n. (-र्थं)
Properly, suitably.
E.
यथा as, अर्थ property.

f. (-ता)
Rectitude, propriety, fitness.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, यथार्थत्वं.

mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं)
Proper, suitable, appropriate.
n. adv. or ind. (-र्हं)
Properly, suitably.
E.
यथा as, अर्हम् properly.

adv.
Properly, fitly.
E.
यथार्ह, and तसि aff.

m. (-र्णः)
A spy, a secret emissary.
E.
यथार्ह properly, suitably, वर्ण form, colour.

adv. n. or ind. (-शं)
According to opportunity.
E.
यथा, and अवकाश season.

ind.
1 Truly, exactly, as it was, according to law or usage.
2 Accordingly, conformably.
E.
यथा, and वति aff.

adv. n. or ind. (-रं)
According to opportunity.
E.
यथा, and अवसर opportunity.

ind. or n. adv.
According to rule.
E.
यथा, and विधि precept.

adv. (-त्तं)
Circumstantially, relating a thing as it happened.
E.
यथा, and वृत्त being.

adv. n. (-क्ति)
Extent of capability, as much as possible.
E.
यथा as much as, and शक्ति power.

adv. n. (-स्त्रं)
According to the Śāstras, agreeably to scripture.
E.
यथा agreeably to, शास्त्र the Śāstras.

adv. (-खं)
Happily.
E.
यथा, and सुख pleasure.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Right, proper, fit, true.
n. (-तं)
Circumstantially, or all that happened or existed.
E.
यथा as, and स्थित fixed, established.

ind.
As, according, or appertaining to, properly, peculiarly.
E.
यथा as, and स्व own, peculiar.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Wished, desired.
adv. n. or ind.(-तं)
1 Willingly, voluntarily.
2 Wilfully, independantly.
E.
यथा as, इप्सित (participle past, desiderative form of आप to obtain), desired, wished.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Wished, desired.
adv. n. or ind. (-ष्टं)
According to will or inclination.

m. (-री)
A bird.
E.
यथा as, इष्ट wished, and चारिन् who goes.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Right, proper.
adv. n. or ind. (-तं)
Properly, suitably.
E.
यथा, and उचित proper.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
As said or explained.
E.
यथा as, उदित said.

n. (-थ्यं)
Rectitude, truth, propriety.
E.
यथातथा, and ष्यञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Just, true, right.
E.
यथार्थ, and ठञ् aff.

n. (-र्थ्यं)
Application, use, accomplishment, attainment of an object.
E.
यथाथ, and ष्यञ् aff.
